interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Agentic Vault keeps plain-Markdown Obsidian memory, budgeted SessionStart handoffs, source-attributed recall, fail-closed git gates and verified backups shared across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI. Release v0.52.1 adds a report-only health-check section 14d for level-2 headings that repeat one ADR-<n> or M-<n> number in a note (headings are never renumbered), marks note lines that start with one of the SessionStart hook's own section headers with the prefix [note line, not a hook header], and makes jev_ask.py --escalate-bizrouter keep the original Jev answer as primary next to the BizRouter answer, with an agreement flag and a provider_disagreement review reason when the two differ. The BizRouter path (--provider bizrouter) now accepts only google/gemini-decision-1, so TypeSafe Jev models are reached only through the direct TypeSafe API. Apart from that narrowing and the version surfaces, these changes alter results only for notes with such headings or lines and for applied escalations. These changes were first tagged as v0.52.0, an unpublished candidate that v0.52.1 supersedes. v0.52.1 also makes the repository's verification and package-build tools and the test fixtures use Windows extended-length paths where a path, with the length reserved for what a run creates or reads below it, reaches the 240-character switch below the plain path limit, and moves vault_lesson_metrics.py to the existing long-path helper so lesson observations work in deeper vault folders on Windows; the release note describes the differences below the switch. Retained from v0.51.0: Windows paths beyond MAX_PATH, SessionStart credential redaction, Antigravity Stop deduplication, zero-issue fresh /vault-init vaults and the opt-in BizRouter Decisions adapter. Retained from v0.50.0: opt-in --worktree-heads lists linked worktrees whose detached HEAD no local branch or tag contains (its --help option realigns the six existing option lines by one column), and repository PR CI cancels superseded runs. The seven certificate-bound checker files are unchanged from v0.46.0 through v0.52.1. Python 3.10+ standard-library runtime; publication does not upgrade active installations or vaults. For transitions from v0.45.1 or earlier, where checker_sha256 changes: if warnings were promoted to fatal, revert them to warning, bring the Claude Code and Codex installations and a git vault's 00-meta/scripts engine copy to the same version (also when rolling back), regenerate the certificate there, then promote again.
